home.introduction:
I am a student at WCSS with a passion for Aerospace Engineering and STEM. 
I'm a cadet with the 706 Snowy Owl Squadron and have completed a rocketry course through cadets. 
I serve as Co-President of the STEM Club, am a student athlete in badminton, a chess team member, and the lead guitarist of @fishhook_.theband. 
I enjoy balancing science, leadership, sports, and music.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a developer with a background in aerospace engineering. My journey began with curiosity about flight and technology, leading me to combine both passions in innovative projects. I enjoy collaborating, learning, and solving real-world problems through code.

items.title: Composition Assistant Agent
items.description: Built an AI agent that can modify a wave file using prompts from the user

items.title: Gmail Autoresponder Agent
items.description: Ability to find and reply to emails with LLM auto-generated responses with casual, normal and proffesional tones

items.title: Chess Game, In Java
items.description: Built a fully functional chess game with engine and LAN play capabilities; with self-made music

items.label: 2nd Place – IEEE Lego Robotics Sumo Competition:
items.description: Developed a LEGO EV3 powered SUMO robot, using scratch, that's ready for battle.

items.label: Euro Challenge (2024):
items.description: Presented innovative solutions to the German Consulate on energy sustainability, population aging, and declining automobile sales.

items.label: WCSS Badminton Team:
items.description: Junior Boys Doubles in my sophomore year

items.title: Robotics Instructor – Jack Donohue Public School, Ottawa, ON
items.description: Using prior experience, taking a leadership role at Robotics club, I led enthusiastic students to better performances at the IEEE LEGO Robotics competition.

items.title: Co-Instructor, STEM Program – University of Ottawa, Ottawa, ON
items.description: Helping organize activities and events to provide learning opportunities for kids with a passion in STEM.
